rows.note: Use this colloquial all-purpose intensifier for something extremely difficult, unpleasant, or otherwise harsh.

example.english: This maths problem is fiendishly difficult.
example.jyutping: ne1 tiu4 sou3 hok6 tai4 gwai2 gam3 naan4 zou6

rows.note: Use this when the manner is malicious, wicked, or deliberately cruel rather than merely intense.

example.english: They spoke fiendishly, deliberately saying things to hurt people.
example.traditional: 佢惡毒咁講埋啲說話，專登刺痛人。
example.jyutping: keoi5 ok3 duk6 gam3 gong2 maai4 di1 syut3 waa6 zyun1 dang1 ci3 tung3 jan4
